channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Logitech Pebble Mouse 2 review: the perfect travel mouse but not a fit for gaming or productivity
item.description: With its handy, compact form factor and ridiculously lengthy battery life, I now exclusively use the Logitech Pebble Mouse 2 when I’m on the go.

item.title: Lenovo leak reveals floating touchscreen that could debut at CES 2027
item.description: Lenovo is developing a 12-inch floating screen with touchscreen gestures, according to a new leak.

item.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
item.description: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots.

item.title: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
item.description: At the upgraded $83/share IPO price, Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company nabbed nearly $105 billion.

item.title: Anthropic rival says companies can (mostly) skip the pricey models
item.description: On the day Anthropic went public, Fireworks AI’s co-founder made the case for open source models as a cheaper alternative, and addressed the breaches that have cost the company some customers’ trust.

item.title: The Large Hadron Collider is being taken apart to fit magnets that have never run in an accelerator before
item.description: The LHC’s new magnets use a superconductor that is too brittle to bend once it forms, so engineers wind the coils first and bake them for days to create it; one in ten coils is still rejected.
